concerns.text: T022-T027 implement peak detection on the 'difference wave' (Deviant - Standard). This violates FR-004 and US-2 which explicitly require calculating peak amplitude/latency for 'standard' and 'deviant' conditions SEPARATELY before comparison. The task list silently relaxes the spec's requirement to measure condition-specific peaks, substituting a difference-wave-only approach.

T018 (epoching) is marked unchecked/failed, yet T022 (extraction) and T027 (metrics) depend on its output (`data/processed/epo_raw.fif`). The task list fails to address this dependency dead-end, effectively dropping the acceptance criterion that US1 must produce valid epochs before US2 can proceed.

SC-005 requires verifying that peak latency falls within the 150–250 ms window for ≥80% of valid participants. T039 only calculates prevalence but lacks a task to verify/flag the 80% threshold or generate evidence for this success criterion, dropping a mandatory acceptance condition.

FR-006 requires a 'non-parametric permutation test... as a substitute for linear scaling analysis'. T033 implements a cluster-based permutation test but lacks explicit verification logic or a task to confirm this satisfies the specific 'substitute' requirement defined in the spec, risking a silent drift from the constitutional analysis plan.
